info.title: Teedy API
info.description: REST API for Teedy (sismics/docs). All endpoints are under `/api`. Authenticate with a session cookie (obtained via `POST /user/login`) or an API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer tdapi_<hex>`. Mutations use `application/x-www-form-urlencoded` bodies unless noted (file upload uses `multipart/form-data`).

servers.description: Live API, resolved relative to this spec at /apidoc/openapi.json so it works under any context path.

get.summary: Get the calling user's own access counts for a document and its files

200.description: Success. `count` is how many times the CALLING user opened this document, and each `files[]` entry carries that same user's own count for one file. The endpoint takes no user parameter, so no request shape can report another user's accesses.

404.description: Document not found, or not readable by the caller

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of documents to rank (default 10, capped at 100)

200.description: Success. Global access totals plus the most-accessed documents with their per-user breakdown. The ranking is restricted to documents the calling administrator may read, so it never names a document the caller could not open.

400.description: ValidationError: limit is not an integer

parameters.name: window
parameters.description: Length of the time series in UTC days (7, 30 or 90)

post.summary: Update a saved filter (rename and/or re-capture its query)
post.description: Teedy convention: PUT creates, POST /{id} updates. Only the name and the query are mutable; the owner, the id and the create date are never modified. The create path's validation applies verbatim.

query.description: Canonical URL query string; keys must be a subset of tags, exclude, mode, search, workflow, with no repeated key and no empty pair

400.description: ValidationError when the name or query is missing, empty, overlength or carries an unsupported/repeated key; AlreadyExistingFilter when another saved filter of the same user already uses the name

404.description: No saved filter with this id is owned by the calling user (a foreign id is indistinguishable from an unknown one)

post.summary: Publish a saved filter to every user
post.description: Owner-only: publishing is an act of authorship, and the shared list names the publisher. An administrator may withdraw a publication (DELETE) but may not create one. Publishing an already-published filter keeps its original publish date. The filter itself is unchanged — only its visibility.

404.description: No saved filter with this id is owned by the calling user (a foreign id is indistinguishable from an unknown one)

delete.description: The owner may withdraw their own publication; an administrator may withdraw anyone's — management, not authorship, so it never edits, renames or deletes the filter. A plain user attempting to withdraw someone else's PUBLISHED filter gets 403 (its existence is already public); an unpublished filter that is not theirs gets 404, the same answer as an unknown id, so the route cannot be used to probe for another user's private filters.

403.description: Not authenticated, or a non-owner without the ADMIN base function attempting to withdraw a published filter

404.description: Unknown id, or another user's unpublished filter

icon.description: The tag's icon: 'emoji:<grapheme>' for a single emoji, or 'set:<iconId>' for an icon from the custom icon set. Empty or absent means no icon.

synonyms.description: Alternative names that resolve to this tag. The whole set is replaced: repeat the parameter once per synonym, send it once with an empty value to remove them all, and omit it to leave them untouched.

400.description: ValidationError when the name or color is invalid; IllegalTagName when the name or a synonym contains a whitespace character inside it, a colon or an asterisk, or is left empty once its invisible format characters are removed and its edges trimmed; ParentNotFound when the parent tag is not readable; CircularReference when the parent tag is a descendant of this one; ValidationError when the icon is not exactly one emoji or names an unknown scheme; IconNotFound when the icon is not in the icon set; TagNameIsSynonym when the name is already a synonym of another visible tag; SynonymInUse when a synonym is already the name or the synonym of another visible tag

404.description: The tag is not writable by the caller

post.summary: Split a synonym into its own tag
post.description: Removes one synonym from the tag and creates a standalone tag with that name, in one transaction. The name is matched against the tag's synonyms ignoring case and the stored spelling becomes the new tag's name; the new tag takes the source tag's colour and parent. Documents stay on the tag they are on — nothing records which name a document was tagged through — so the new tag starts empty.

name.description: The synonym to split off into its own tag.

400.description: ValidationError when the name is not one of this tag's synonyms; IllegalTagName when the name contains a whitespace character inside it, a colon or an asterisk, or is left empty once its invisible format characters are removed and its edges trimmed; TagNameIsSynonym when the name is already a synonym of another visible tag

404.description: The tag is not writable by the caller

403.description: Not authenticated, or the calling account stopped being active before the tag was created

get.description: Returns, for every visible tag, whether its whole subtree is unused and can be deleted, and when it cannot, why. Nothing is modified.

delete.description: Deletes every tag whose entire subtree carries no document, and reports exactly which tags were deleted. Tags still carrying documents are never touched.

post.description: Removes from each of the given documents every tag that has a descendant tag on that same document, so a document tagged Insurance / Car / 2026 in full keeps only 2026. Defaults to a dry run: nothing is modified unless dryRun is false. The removal set is always derived server-side from the current state — the client sends document IDs only. Tags the caller cannot read never cause a removal, and documents the caller cannot write are reported as skipped rather than modified.

400.description: ValidationError - Too many documents in one run

delete.description: Deletes a tag and all its descendants, but only when none of them carries a document. Unlike DELETE /tag/{id} this never un-assigns a tag from a document.

400.description: TagSubtreeInUse - The subtree still carries documents (active or in the trash); TagSubtreeInRule - The subtree holds a tag an auto-tagging rule points at; TagNotDeletable - Refused without a reason the caller is told

200.description: Success: every icon in the instance custom tag icon set

put.summary: Add an icon to the tag icon set

name.description: The name shown beside the icon in the picker

image.description: PNG or SVG image, at most 32 KiB. The type is decided from the CONTENT, not from the declared type or the file name.

400.description: ValidationError when the name is missing or too long; NoImageProvided when no image was sent; InvalidImageType when the content is neither a PNG nor an SVG; InvalidImageContent when an SVG carries scripting or external references; PayloadTooLarge when the image exceeds 32 KiB

403.description: Not authenticated, or not an administrator

500.description: CopyError when the icon could not be written to the icon store

get.description: The compiled stylesheet: the generated navbar colour rule, then the legacy `css` config field, then the stored `custom.css`.

put.description: The request body is the raw CSS. Replaces the effective custom CSS: it is stored as `custom.css` and the legacy `css` config field is cleared.

400.description: The body is not valid UTF-8

413.description: The stylesheet exceeds the 256 KiB limit

delete.description: Removes `custom.css` AND clears the legacy `css` config field, so a reset cannot leave older CSS active.

get.description: The stored custom JavaScript, or an empty body when none is configured. Served as an external same-origin script with a JavaScript media type and `X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff`.

put.description: The request body is the raw JavaScript. Admin-injected script runs for every user of the instance.

400.description: The body is not valid UTF-8

413.description: The script exceeds the 256 KiB limit

main_color.description: Brand colour the UI palette is derived from; null when the feature is off

css.description: Effective custom CSS (legacy config field plus the stored custom.css)

favicon_version.description: Cache-bust token for the favicon (0 when the bundled default is served)

logo_version.description: Cache-bust token for the logo (0 when the bundled default is served)

background_version.description: Cache-bust token for the background (0 when the bundled default is served)

stylesheet_version.description: Cache-bust token for /theme/stylesheet, derived from the compiled body

script_version.description: Cache-bust token for /theme/script, derived from the served body

post.description: Every field is optional: an ABSENT parameter preserves the stored value, an EMPTY one clears it. A supplied `css` replaces the effective custom CSS (stored as `custom.css`, legacy field cleared).

413.description: The stylesheet exceeds the 256 KiB limit

delete.summary: Reset a theme image to the bundled default

locale.description: Preferred UI locale code (e.g. de, zh_CN); must be a supported SPA locale

dark_mode.description: Persisted per-user dark-mode preference. Absent leaves the stored value unchanged (absent is not false); any other value is a validation error

parameters.description: Username of the surviving user to reassign this user's documents and tags to. Required only when the departing user still owns an active document or tag; the request is refused with the ReassignRequired error otherwise.

400.description: ReassignRequired when the departing user still owns documents or tags and no target was supplied; ValidationError when the supplied target is empty, inactive, unknown, or is the departing user itself; UserNotFound when no active user has this username; ForbiddenError when the target of the deletion is the guest user or an administrator
